label: sdc01_0310_sister_01
text: Hey, Grandpa! We got the Crystal Cluster you\nneeded![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

text: He ran off with the mask.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0310_sister_03
text: What? Why would Kiki do that?![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

text: Did you tell him about the ogre or something?![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

text: Right, I’m sorry... I know you wouldn’t just go\nblabbing to him like that.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

text: Kieran has been brooding about something for\nthe past few days.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

text: We should head to Loyalty Plaza and figure out\nwhat’s gotten into Kieran.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

text: Have you seen crystals like the ones in the\nCrystal Pool back home in Paldea?[VAR 0x0114(0042)]
